scripts.text: You have too many kind of belongings. Let's try again after reducing the kind of items.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多了。請減少物品種類後再試一次。

scripts.text: Your belongings are too heavy to continue. Let's try again after reducing the weight.
scripts.translation:
你的負重過高，無法繼續。
請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Jeum-sun]
I am still living in the memory. Make more memories...
scripts.translation:
[佔善]
我依然活在回憶中。去創造更多回憶吧...

scripts.text:
[Jeum-sun]
Oh are you level 140 yet? I won't talk to any weak adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[佔善]
哦，你到140級了嗎？我可不跟太弱的冒險者說話。

scripts.text:
[Jeum-sun]
When I was a young girl many years ago there was a man who I had crush on. I didn't know to tell him how I felt...
scripts.translation:
[佔善]
很多年前，我還是個年輕女孩的時候，有個男人讓我心動不已。我當時不知道該怎麼告訴他我的心意...

scripts.text:
[Jeum-sun]
I used to tease his Peco Peco and wanted him to notice that I was interested. This went on and on for a while.
scripts.translation:
[佔善]
我總愛逗弄他的大嘴鳥，想讓他注意到我對他有意思。這樣持續了一段時間。

scripts.text:
[Jeum-sun]
Then we started dating somehow. It's still embarrasing to talk about it.
scripts.translation:
[佔善]
後來不知怎麼的，我們就開始交往了。說起來還是讓人害羞。

scripts.text:
[Jeum-sun]
Anyway, we got married when we became old enough to marry. He used to say sorry for not being able to afford to buy a ring for me.
scripts.translation:
[佔善]
總之，我們到了適婚年齡就結婚了。他總說抱歉，買不起戒指送給我。

scripts.text:
[Jeum-sun]
It has been 40 years since we were married and he still says ^0000ff'Darling~ Do you want to have a ring?'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[佔善]
我們結婚已經40年了，他還是會說^0000ff“親愛的~你想戴戒指嗎？”^000000

scripts.text:
[Jeum-sun]
I told him.. What good is a ring for an old lady?
scripts.translation:
[佔善]
我就跟他說...都一把年紀了，還要戒指做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Jeum-sun]
I should have stopped him. I still remember his face early.
scripts.translation:
[佔善]
早知道就該攔住他，那時他的神情，我至今記得清清楚楚。

scripts.text: What happened to him?
scripts.translation: 他怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Jeum-sun]
He had not came back since he left home to buy a ring.
scripts.translation:
[佔善]
他出門去買戒指後，就再也沒有回來過。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe old lady turned her face down with reddened eyes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff老婦人低下了頭，眼眶泛紅。^000000

scripts.text: Stop talking.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Show the ring from the Faceworm's Nest.
scripts.translation: 展示來自驚駭森靈巢穴的戒指

scripts.text:
[Jeum-sun]
What about this ring?
scripts.translation:
[佔善]
這枚戒指...？

scripts.text:
[Jeum-sun]
Oh... Darling~
scripts.translation:
[佔善]
哦...親愛的~

scripts.text:
^0000ffThe lady read an inscription inside the ring and started weeping.
[Jeum-sun, my darling flower]^000000
scripts.translation:
^0000ff老婦人讀著戒指內側的銘文，淚水奪眶而出。
[佔善，我心愛的花兒]^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou sense a warm energy emanating. Maybe this is the wish of the man who made this ring.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你感受到一股溫暖的力量散發出來。也許這是製作這枚戒指的男人的心願。^000000

scripts.text: The warm energy has inspired you with strength.
scripts.translation: 溫暖的能量讓你渾身充滿力量。

scripts.text: The lady keeps crying over and over holding a ring. It seems to be no use talking to her right now.
scripts.translation:
老婦人緊握著戒指，淚流不止。
現在還是別打擾她了。

scripts.text: Sadly, this woman does not seem to remember the past because of abrupt emotional changes. Let's talk carefully and listen to her story.
scripts.translation:
遺憾的是，老婦人情緒起伏太大，似乎又記不清往事了。
小心地與她交談，聽聽她的故事吧。

scripts.text: You have too many types of belongings. Let's try again after reducing the types of items.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多了，請清理背包後再試。

scripts.text: Your belongings are too heavy to continue. Let's try again after reducing the weight.
scripts.translation:
你的負重過高，無法繼續。
請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Sergio]
Fortune or fame is not important. The most important thing is family.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾吉奧]
財富或名聲並不重要。最重要的是家人。

scripts.text:
[Sergio]
Are you at least level 140 yet?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾吉奧]
你至少達到140級了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sergio]
I have a blurry memory of when I used to travel with my father's armed-merchant group.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾吉奧]
我隱約記得，我曾跟隨父親的武裝商隊旅行。

scripts.text:
[Sergio]
I vaguely remember everyone of the group were scattered after being attacked by a giant snake-like creature.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾吉奧]
我模糊地記得，商隊在遭到一種巨大的蛇形生物襲擊後，成員們四散奔逃。

scripts.text:
[Sergio]
I had lost my family at that time. I do not clearly remember even their faces.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾吉奧]
那時我失去了家人。我甚至記不清他們的面容。

scripts.text:
[Sergio]
Now I've made my own armed-merchant group and got my life back. But the memory of my past keeps haunting me.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾吉奧]
如今我有了自己的武裝商隊，生活也重回正軌，可往事始終揮之不去。

scripts.text:
[Sergio]
I just stopped by this town to possibly find a record of my family and the armed-merchant group but so far I've found nothing.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾吉奧]
我路過這個城鎮，希望能找到關於家人和武裝商隊的記錄，但至今一無所獲。

scripts.text: Stop talking.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Show him the Old Photo Album
scripts.translation: 給他看陳舊的相簿

scripts.text:
[Sergio]
Yes! I remembered. This is the one who used to work for my father's armed-merchant group.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾吉奧]
對！我想起來了，這人以前在我父親的武裝商隊裡做事。

scripts.text:
[Sergio]
Oh my... There are other pictures here too...
scripts.translation:
[塞爾吉奧]
天哪...這裡還有其他照片...

scripts.text: ^0000ffA smile of lonely satisfaction spreads over the face of Sergio while looking at a photo album.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff塞爾吉奧望著相簿，臉上浮現出寂寥而滿足的微笑。^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffA gentle energy surrounds Sergio.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff一股溫柔的力量環繞著塞爾吉奧。^000000

scripts.text: You are touched by seeing the satisfaction on Sergio's face.
scripts.translation: 看到塞爾吉奧滿足的神情，你深受感動。

scripts.text: Sergio keeps looking at the photo album. Let's leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 塞爾吉奧仍在翻看相簿，先別打擾他吧。

scripts.text: You can talk to Sergio again when you pick up a new photo album from the Faceworm's Nest.
scripts.translation: 從驚駭森靈巢穴找到新的相簿後，可以再來與塞爾吉奧交談。

scripts.text: You have too many types of belongings. Let's try again after reducing the types of items.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多了，請清理背包後再試。

scripts.text: Your belongings are too heavy to continue. Let's try again after reducing the weight.
scripts.translation:
你的負重過高，無法繼續。
請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Dol-Seoi]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[石牛]
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dol-Seoi]
Are you at least level 140 yet?
scripts.translation:
[石牛]
你至少達到140級了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dol-Seoi]
I used to be a servant to a very wealthy lady. She was always kind to me but she suffered from a severe cough that wouldn't go away unless she took a special pill.
scripts.translation:
[石牛]
我以前侍奉過一位富有的夫人，她待我一直很好。
可她咳嗽得很厲害，只有吃一種特殊藥丸才能好轉。

scripts.text:
[Dol-Seoi]
I used to get the pill from a group of armed-merchants but I heard that they were attacked by a snake and that's when I couldn't get any more pills.
scripts.translation:
[石牛]
那種藥丸以前都是從一支武裝商隊買的。
後來聽說商隊被一條大蛇襲擊了，從此再也買不到藥丸。

scripts.text:
[Dol-Seoi]
I searched everywhere but no one could get that pill for me so eventually my lady passed away. If it wasn't for that slithering...
scripts.translation:
[石牛]
我四處打聽，還是沒人能弄到那種藥，夫人最終還是過世了。
要不是那條爬蟲...

scripts.text: Do you want to revenge?
scripts.translation: 你想復仇嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dol-Seoi]
Well...

[Dol-Seoi]
Yes... But, I have nothing to do with that snake. I am just a worthless servant who once served for my lady.
scripts.translation:
[石牛]
想...可是，我又能拿那條蛇怎麼樣？
我不過是個沒用的僕人，曾經侍奉過夫人罷了。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou catch a glimpse of complicated rage and sorrow in his eyes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你在他眼中瞥見了交織的憤怒與悲傷。^000000

scripts.text: Stop talking.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Show him the Old Pill.
scripts.translation: 給他看古老的藥丸

scripts.text:
[Dol-Seoi]
Wait! Where did you get this?
scripts.translation:
[石牛]
等等！你從哪裡得到這個的？

scripts.text: I killed a snake...
scripts.translation: 我殺了一條蛇...

scripts.text:
[Dol-Seoi]
This pill... My lady, if I had this pill...
scripts.translation:
[石牛]
這藥丸...夫人，要是當時有這藥丸...

scripts.text: ^0000ffHe begins to weep like a wounded Muka. She must have meant a lot to him...^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff他像受傷的摩卡一樣開始哭泣。她對他一定很重要...^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffI feel gentle energy around Dol-Seoi.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff我感覺到石牛周圍有溫和的能量。^000000

scripts.text: Dol-Seoi is standing absent-mindedly clutching the Old Pill. Let's leave him alone now.
scripts.translation:
石牛攥著古老的藥丸，怔怔地站在那裡。
先讓他一個人靜一靜吧。

scripts.text: You can talk to Dol-Seoi again if you get another Old Pill from the Faceworm's Nest.
scripts.translation: 如果你從驚駭森靈巢穴中再獲得一顆古老的藥丸，你可以再次與石牛交談。

scripts.text: You have too many types of belongings. Let's try again after reducing the types of items.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多了，請清理背包後再試。

scripts.text: Your belongings are too heavy to continue. Let's try again after reducing the weight.
scripts.translation:
你的負重過高，無法繼續。
請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text:
[Keaton]
...

[Keaton]
Unless you're level 140, I won't have a real conversation with you.
scripts.translation:
[基頓]
不到140級，我可不會認真跟你說話。

scripts.text: ^0000ffIt looks like a dead soul but you don't feel maliciousness from it. His thoughts have been delivered piece by piece so it isn't easy to understand.^000000
scripts.translation:
^0000ff他似乎是個亡魂，卻沒有惡意。
傳達來的思緒斷斷續續，難以理解。^000000

scripts.text:
^999999[Keaton]
Keaton... Not good at speaking.^000000

^999999[Keaton]
Keaton has died long time ago. Keaton is not bad.^000000
scripts.translation:
^999999[基頓]
基頓死了，很久了。
基頓不是壞人。^000000

scripts.text:
^999999[Keaton]
Keaton... Need bracelet, that is important. Keaton's friend gave the bracelet.^000000
scripts.translation:
^999999[基頓]
基頓...要手鍊，很重要。
朋友送給基頓的手鍊。^000000

scripts.text:
^999999[Keaton]
Keaton, will go after a snake to find a bracelet. The bad snake killed keaton.^000000
scripts.translation:
^999999[基頓]
基頓要去追蛇，找回手鍊。壞蛇殺了基頓。^000000

scripts.text: Stop talking.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Show him the Rusty Bracelet.
scripts.translation: 給他看生鏽的手鍊

scripts.text:
^999999[Keaton]
It is the bracelet of Keaton!!^000000

^999999[Keaton]
Keaton...glad. Defeat bad snake!!^000000
^0000ffKeaton seems to shine brighter.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff基頓似乎變得更加明亮了。^000000

scripts.text: Keaton's soul seems to be smiling. Best to give him whatever peace he can have for now.
scripts.translation:
基頓的靈魂似乎在微笑。
暫且讓他享受這片刻安寧吧。

scripts.text: Keaton is very sad maybe it is because the bracelet was broken. Bring him any other Rusty Bracelets found in the Faceworm's Nest.
scripts.translation:
基頓很傷心，或許是因為手鍊斷了。
若在驚駭森靈巢穴找到別的生鏽的手鍊，再拿來給他吧。

scripts.text: There's no sign because no one updates the record.
scripts.translation: 沒有記錄，因為沒有人更新它。

最佳紀錄屬於冒險者 ^ff0044{0}^000000{1}。

scripts.translation:
-- 驚駭森靈巢穴記錄 --
最佳紀錄屬於冒險者 ^ff0044{0}^000000，隊伍人數為^ff0044{1}^000000。
當前紀錄時間為 ^0000ff{2}分{3}秒^000000。

scripts.text:
-- Faceworm's Nest Records --
Best time belongs to adventurer ^ff0044{0}^000000 with ^ff0044{1} party members^000000.
Current record time is ^0000ff{2} Minute {3} {4}^000000.

scripts.translation:
-- 驚駭森靈巢穴記錄 --
最佳紀錄屬於冒險者 ^ff0044{0}^000000，隊伍人數為^ff0044{1}^000000。
當前紀錄時間為 ^0000ff{2}秒^000000。

scripts.text:
-- Faceworm's Nest Records --
Best time belongs to adventurer ^ff0044{0}^000000 with ^ff0044{1} party members^000000.
Current record time is ^0000ff{2} {3}^000000.

[Magic Scholar]
You are not qualified enough to enter here. How about visiting other places until you become level 140.
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
你的實力還不足以進入這裡。
先去別處歷練，等到140級再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Magic Scholar]
You don't have a party? Please come back again after creating a party even if you've come alone.
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
沒有隊伍嗎？即使獨自前往，也請先組建隊伍再來。

scripts.text:
[Magic Scholar]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Reserve Faceworm's Nest
scripts.translation: 預約驚駭森靈巢穴

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Stop Talking.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Magic Scholar]
Oops, my hands are slip off. It is required to activate the craks again.
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
哎呀，手滑了，得重新啟用裂縫。

scripts.text:
[Magic Scholar]
The spaces are under control.
Please wait for a minute.
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
正在穩定空間，請稍等。

scripts.text:
[Magic Scholar]
Okay, I got it. Please come back again if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
好的，我明白了。如果你改變主意，請再回來。

scripts.text:
[Magic Scholar]
I am researching the dimensional cracks in space here.
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
我正在研究這裡的空間裂縫。

scripts.text:
[Magic Scholar]
My research is to stabilize the space here with magic to utilize it for dimensional travel.
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
我研究如何用魔法穩定這裡的空間，以便進行次元旅行。

scripts.text:
[Magic Scholar]
This particular crack in space goes to a memory of the past. Many adventurers have been in there but no one will tell me what is in there...
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
這道特殊的空間裂縫通往過去的記憶。
進去過的冒險者不少，卻沒人肯說裡面有什麼...

scripts.text:
[Magic Scholar]
And there's this strange sign here that records names and times on it which I can only assume belongs to those adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
還有這塊奇怪的牌子，上面記著名字和時間。
我只能猜，那些是冒險者的名字。

scripts.text:
[Magic Scholar]
Anyways, I can activate the passage for you if you're a party leader.
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
總之，如果你是隊長，我可以為你啟用通道。

scripts.text:
[Magic Scholar]
The crack in time is not safe enough to pass back and forth. Please come back again if the after effect timer has passed.
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
穿越時間裂縫並不安全，不能來回折騰。
等上次穿越的影響消退後再來吧。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe trace of dimensional space travelling has disappeared. You can now move between dimensions.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff空間旅行的痕跡已經消失。你現在可以在次元之間移動了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Interdimensional Device]
Your power level is not high enough to travel the space. Please come back again when you reach at least level 140.
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
你的實力不足以穿越空間，請達到140級後再來。

scripts.text:
[Interdimensional Device]
No party? Please come back again after creating a party even if you've come alone.
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
沒有隊伍？即使獨自前往，也請先組建隊伍再來。

scripts.text:
[Interdimensional Device]
An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
發生未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Interdimensional Device]
The passage for space travel is not activated yet.
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
空間旅行通道尚未啟用。

scripts.text:
[Interdimensional Device]
You are not allowed to access the device.
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
你無權訪問該裝置。

scripts.text:
[Interdimensional Device]
Traces of recent space travel have been detected. Access is denied.
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
檢測到近期空間旅行的痕跡。拒絕訪問。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe trace of dimensional space travelling has disappeared. You can now move between dimensions.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff空間旅行的痕跡已經消失。你現在可以在次元之間移動了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
I do not know what this is about, but I'm talking to your leader so please wait for a while ok?
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
我不知道這是怎麼回事，但我正在和你的隊長交談，請稍等片刻，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Really? I didn't know that a bounty hunter was coming here.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
真的嗎？我不知道會有賞金獵人來這裡。

scripts.text: Wait! It's a misunderstanding.
scripts.translation: 等等！這是個誤會

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No! I think you're mistaken! We are not bounty hunters...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不！我想你搞錯了！我們不是賞金獵人...

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
No, No need to make an excuse... The faceworm belongs to nobody.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
不不，不用解釋...人面蟲又不是誰家的，誰都能打。

scripts.text: Faceworm?
scripts.translation: 人面蟲？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Faceworm? I've never heard about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人面蟲？我從沒聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Sorry~ I enjoy a gentle breeze so talk to me next time.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
抱歉啦~我正在享受這陣微風，下次再聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
I do not know what this is about, but I'm talking to your leader so please wait for a while ok?
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
我不知道這是怎麼回事，但我正在和你的隊長交談，請稍等片刻，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Wow, you're fast enough to follow me.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
哇，你速度真快，能跟上我。

scripts.text: The big one, just right before...
scripts.translation: 那個大的，就在剛才...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The big one just right before we saw is a boss here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
剛才那個大傢伙就是這裡的首領嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
No~~ It can't be the faceworm queen.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
不~~ 它不可能是人面蟲皇后。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Chaos is a good friend even though he's only able to use Magnum Break...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
混沌雖然只會怒爆，倒也是個好夥伴...

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
I do not know what this is about, but I'm talking to your leader so please wait for a while ok?
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
我不知道這是怎麼回事，但我正在和你的隊長交談，請稍等片刻，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
You're pretty good! But you have to be careful from now on. This narrow canyon seems to be full of dangers.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
你挺厲害的！但從現在開始要小心了。這條狹窄的峽谷似乎充滿了危險。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
This canyon. I am not feeling good here. I don't want to stay anymore.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
這條峽谷讓我渾身不自在，一刻也不想多待。

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Hew. This puddle is weird.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
呼，這灘水真古怪。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Something seems fishy around here. It's dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
這裡有些不對勁。很危險。

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Hmm.. You are pretty good, I am impressed.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
嗯...你挺厲害的，我很佩服。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
That was dangerous. Hehehe...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
剛才好危險。嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Dimensional Device]
Your time is finished here. You may look arround or go leave. What do you want to do?
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
你在這裡的時間已經結束，可以再四處看看，也可以離開。
你打算怎麼做？

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text: Return to Dimensional Gap
scripts.translation: 返回次元裂縫

scripts.text:
[Time Manager]
What time would you like to return?
scripts.translation:
[時間管理員]
你想返回哪個時間點？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.translation: 第一階段開始
